home.subtitle: Live consoles — host and question agent

connectionBadge.unauthorized: NOT CONNECTED — token missing or rejected

pilotTokenGate.title: Pilot token required
pilotTokenGate.intro: Enter the token of the game session to pilot. It is displayed read-only in the back-office (session record).
pilotTokenGate.provisionalWarning: ⚠️ PROVISIONAL, unspecified host auth: opaque token per session (X-Pilot-Token header). This mechanism will be replaced once decided.
pilotTokenGate.label: Pilot token
pilotTokenGate.storageHint: The token is kept for the browsing session and never displayed again. Without a valid token, the controls stay inactive.

hostConsole.title: Host console
hostConsole.subtitle: Elimination format — server state, never optimistic (F-1)

fillerReminder.title: After each question: fill ≈ {{seconds}} s
fillerReminder.detail: Personal window, not absolute — chaining too fast cuts off lagging players. Unvalidated value (20-25 s ballpark).

errors.auth: Token rejected by the server (401/404) — check the session token. Controls inactive.
errors.network: Server unreachable — check the link. Controls inactive.

createTheme.title: New game (elimination format)
createTheme.intro: Creates the theme and schedules its first round. The theme targets ONE population (I-1) — studio or home, never both.

gameResult.title: Game result
gameResult.placeholder: The game is running — the winners draw (I-28) will appear here after “End the game”.
gameResult.finishedElsewhere: Game over (draw already done — the detail is not re-read by the contract).

closeWindow.label: CLOSE THE WINDOW
closeWindow.hint: The server rejects outside the window (I-2)

nextRound.label: NEXT ROUND
nextRound.hint: Schedules round N+1 — validated question required (EX-40). Disabled while the current window is not closed.

finishGame.label: END THE GAME
finishGame.hint: Draws the winners among the survivors (I-28) — idempotent server-side.

openWindow.title: Open the window?
openWindow.body: Players in the theme’s population will be able to answer. Opening is announced by the app, never by the picture (I-3).

closeWindow.title: Close the window?
closeWindow.body: Outside the window, the server rejects every answer (I-2). Players currently typing will be cut off.

nextRound.title: Schedule the next round?
nextRound.body: Reserved for survivors (EX-32): nobody joins a game midway. The current window must be closed.

finishGame.title: End the game?
finishGame.body: Triggers the winners draw among the survivors (I-28). The server rejects until the 5 rounds are closed. Idempotent action.

questionAgent.title: Question agent console
questionAgent.subtitle: I-33 — the model proposes, the human validates. Nothing goes on air without validation.

transcription.title: Live transcription (timestamped)
transcription.placeholder: Placeholder — the timestamped transcription will appear here.
transcription.placeholderHint: Each line will carry a clickable time code (jump back to the passage and the sound).

questions.title: Questions proposed by the model
questions.placeholderHint: The model’s proposals will appear here during the show.

actions.correctHint: Workshop edit — nothing goes on air
actions.disabledReason: Actions disabled: no question to process and console not connected.
